sentences.en: Objective To reconstruct the proteinic sequence of human cathelicidin LL-37 to increase the bactericidal activity of LL-37 and to express the reconstructed LL-37 (rLL-37) in bacterium.

sentences.en: It can identify the subtle changes of the proteinic contents in the tumor's cells, tissues and bodies. Moreover, it can precisely analyse the chemical and physical qualities of a certain protein.
